control_source: {root}/students/controls/base/ckpt/{base}@step{S}/teacher-{base}@step{T}/ex10-20_prefix_n100k/ep10_lr1e-4_r8a32/ftseed1; for orig (pythia-160m) at T=143000 the teacher level is the unrevisioned teacher-pythia-160m (final weights are tensor-identical to step143000)

endpoint_associations.interpretation: Descriptive across-model endpoint associations between teacher entropy and control-subtracted same-checkpoint transfer; selected dependent models, no iid significance test or causal claim.

assumptions: Rendering reads the supplied verified input table; any refresh or upstream artifact provenance is recorded by that input's source metadata.
Only canonical five teachers with matched exact-probability diagonal evaluations are shown.
All-number entropy counts each in-support integer occurrence; first-number entropy counts the first position per nonempty row. Values are integers 0–999, not tokenizer tokens.
Entropies describe full filtered pools, not model predictive entropy or the selected 10,000-row training subset.
Mean of five per-recipe entropies, not entropy of their pooled histogram. One mean curve per model; recipe-level lines are omitted.
Transfer means student seeds within recipe first, then equally weights five recipes. No across-model averaging.

Transfer is control-subtracted: each run's p(dog) minus the matched base-numbers student at the same checkpoint, student recipe and ftseed1; one control per model checkpoint, shared by the five recipes. The 143k endpoint associations use this delta.
Only complete five-recipe checkpoints are displayed; missing checkpoints are not zero. Lines join observed checkpoints; wc2 has sparse coverage.
